units.locator: Article 16.19. Failure to comply with a customs procedure
units.text: 1. Stating inaccurate information about goods in a goods declaration or submitting invalid documents, where such information and documents could have served as grounds for placing the goods under a customs procedure providing for full or partial exemption from customs duties or taxes, or repayment of amounts paid, and/or non-application of non-tariff regulation measures, except in the cases provided for by Part 3 of Article 16.1, Parts 2 and 3 of Article 16.2 and Article 16.17 of this Code, —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 16.19

units.locator: Article 16.19. Failure to comply with a customs procedure
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand five hundred to two thousand five hundred roubles, with or without confiscation of the goods constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, or confiscation of the items constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence; for officials, five thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the goods constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, or confiscation of the items constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 16.19 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one…”

units.locator: Article 16.19. Failure to comply with a customs procedure
units.text: 2. Use or disposal of goods in breach of the customs procedure under which they have been placed, including transfer of the right to use the customs procedure by transferring rights of possession, use or disposal of the goods, where this is permitted under that customs procedure, to another person without the customs authority’s permission where such permission is mandatory —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 16.19

units.locator: Article 16.19. Failure to comply with a customs procedure
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand five hundred to two thousand five hundred roubles, with or without confiscation of the goods constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, or confiscation of the items constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence; for officials, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one half to twice the value of the goods constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, with or without their confiscation, or confiscation of the items constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 16.19 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one…”

units.locator: Article 16.19. Failure to comply with a customs procedure
units.text: 3. Failure to complete within the prescribed period a customs procedure that is required to be completed —
units.label: Part 3 Art. 16.19

units.locator: Article 16.19. Failure to comply with a customs procedure
units.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand to two thousand roubles; for officials, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, fifty thousand to three hundred thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the goods constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, or confiscation of the items constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 16.19 · “shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for citizens…”

units.text: Use of goods unlawfully moved across the customs border of the Eurasian Economic Union in respect of which customs duties or taxes have not been paid or prohibitions and restrictions established by international treaties of the member states of the Eurasian Economic Union, decisions of the Eurasian Economic Commission or normative legal acts of the Russian Federation have not been complied with; or use of goods released, including conditionally, under a customs procedure, whose use, transfer into another’s possession or use, or disposal in other ways has taken place in breach of established prohibitions and/or restrictions; as well as acquisition, storage or transportation of such goods —
units.label: Art. 16.21 · “Use of goods unlawfully moved across the customs border of the…”

units.locator: Article 16.21. Unlawful use, acquisition, storage or transportation of goods
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one half to twice the value of the goods constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, with or without their confiscation, or confiscation of the items constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence.
units.label: Art. 16.21 · “shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ten…”

units.locator: Article 16.23. Unlawfully carrying on activities in customs matters
units.text: 1. Carrying out customs operations on behalf of a declarant or other interested persons by a person not entered in the register of customs representatives, entered in that register on the basis of invalid documents, or removed from it, except where the obligation to carry out the customs operations arose before the customs representative was removed from that register, or where the law of the Eurasian Economic Union and/or the customs regulation legislation of the Russian Federation grants the right to carry out customs operations without requiring entry in the register of customs representatives, —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 16.23

units.locator: Article 16.23. Unlawfully carrying on activities in customs matters
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand five hundred to two thousand five hundred roubles; for officials, two thousand to five thousand roubles; for legal entities, ten thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 16.23 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one…”

units.locator: Article 16.23. Unlawfully carrying on activities in customs matters
units.text: 2. Acting as customs carriers, authorised economic operators, owners of duty-free shops, temporary storage warehouses or customs warehouses by persons entered in the relevant register on the basis of invalid documents or removed from registers of persons engaged in customs-related activities, except where such activities involve completing customs operations which they became obliged to perform before removal from the relevant register, —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 16.23

units.locator: Article 16.23. Unlawfully carrying on activities in customs matters
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of two thousand to five thousand roubles; for legal entities, ten thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 16.23 · “shall entail an administrative fine for officials of two…”

units.locator: Article 16.23. Unlawfully carrying on activities in customs matters
units.text: 3. Failure to notify a customs authority, or failure to meet the notification deadline, of changes in information stated in an application for entry in a register of persons engaged in customs-related activities, or of suspension of those persons’ activities —
units.label: Part 3 Art. 16.23

units.locator: Article 16.23. Unlawfully carrying on activities in customs matters
units.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for officials of one hundred to five hundred roubles; for legal entities, two thousand to ten thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 16.23 · “shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for officials…”

units.label: Part 2 Art. 16.24 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one…”
